g.text: Four kinds of reasons, and only one is refusal
Researchers group the causes as barriers, aversions, disengagement, and myths.
A negative school climate, or no
Fears such as lice, and the belief that
an excused absence does not count.
Three of the four are conditions a district can change.
The EPA estimates 10.5 million school days are lost to asthma each year.
Illustration, not a photograph of any school
Source: Framework for Action: Addressing Chronic Absenteeism through ESSA (ERIC ED617466, 2017); EPA asthma figure cited there.
